description: kube-noob verify before a kubectl, oc or helm command changes a cluster. Off until you turn on verify_cluster_commands in /config; while off, the hook is a POSIX sh guard that starts no program.

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_VERIFY_CLUSTER_COMMANDS" in [Tt][Rr][Uu][Ee]|1|[Yy][Ee][Ss]|[Oo][Nn]) exec uv run --frozen --exact --isolated --quiet --project "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" python -I -B "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/kube_noob_hook.py";; esac
